answer_sql:
SELECT
  c.country_name,
  SUM(s.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_key) AS average_order_value
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON s.sale_country_code = c.country_code
GROUP BY
  c.country_name
ORDER BY
  average_order_value DESC
